notes: Covers the Sony KDL-32BX330 and KDL-32BX331 (AZ3FZ chassis) for the US/Canada and Mexico/Latin America destinations; the A board number differs for the LA models. Sony's caution says to unplug the TV before replacing the CCFL backlight or the inverter circuit, where about 650 Vrms occurs.

gaps: The manual covers two models: speaker output is 6 W + 6 W for the KDL-32BX330 and 8 W + 8 W for the -331, but the loudspeaker part is listed once for both.
The spec table prints one power figure, 84 W in use, for both models; it is not attached to any part.

The manual names an A board, a G1 (power supply) board, an H board and a balancer board, and never says which is the main board or what the balancer board does, so both are filed under controller_board only as the nearest key; no main-board or inverter role is claimed.
The electrical parts list shows the H board with no part number (NA); the exploded view gives 1-895-120-11.
The LCD panel module row in the exploded view shows N/A for its part number; the number given is the liquid crystal element, 1-811-562-11.
The CCFL lamps are listed without a part number. Speaker impedance is not given.
The electrical parts list is long and mixed with schematic text; no chip names were read from it, so none are claimed.
Years were removed: 2012 is the manual's issue date (1/2012), not a production range.
method: Sony KDL-32BX330/32BX331 service manual (AZ3FZ chassis, issue 1/2012), PDF on the Internet Archive (item manualslib-id-1064970, file 257c88.pdf, 40 PDF pages), read as text with the research tool; pages 8 and 30 rendered and looked at.
PDF pages used: 4 (caution), 8 (specifications), 29 to 31 (exploded views and miscellaneous parts), 32 (protection and diagnostic table), 36 (electrical parts list board entries).
Schematic pages were not used for claims. No FCC filing or other source was used for this model.

comps.spec: CCFL backlight lamps (the exploded view lists 'CCFL LAMPS' with no part number). The back light unit is part 1-895-119-11
Diffuser sheet 4-417-321-01 and diffuser plate 4-417-320-01 (32 T1); main reflector 4-421-647-01 and side reflector R 4-421-648-01
G1 power board, mounted, part 1-895-089-21; the manual's diagrams call it the power supply board. Sony says component-level repair information is not available for it. The set runs on 120 V AC 60 Hz
Loudspeaker, part 1-858-589-11; two full-range speakers 30 x 100 mm. Speaker output 6 W + 6 W on the KDL-32BX330 and 8 W + 8 W on the -331
A board, mounted, part 1-895-088-21 (US/CND/MX models; 1-895-088-31 for LA models). Sony says component-level repair information is not available for it
H board, mounted, part 1-895-120-11, attached to the bezel with double-sided tape. Sony says component-level repair information is not available for it
Balancer board, part 1-895-203-11, in the LCD panel module exploded view with the CCFL lamps
LCD panel element C32BJ2-P03, part 1-811-562-11 (the LCD panel module row shows N/A for its part number)
